entries.subject: The alternative ZDI maps with differential rotation
entries.finding: The paper's appendix shows maps made with a differential rotation for some stars; its VizieR deposit holds only the solid-body maps, which are the ones in its main figures and shown here.

entries.subject: Earlier ZDI maps of this star
entries.finding: The paper compares with earlier maps (Rosén et al. 2016; Hackman et al. 2016; Waite et al. 2015). They are published as figures, not as data, so they are not shown.
entries.revisitWhen: An earlier map is deposited as data.
